description: This file declares the WebRtcController class, which manages WebRTC-related functionalities such as starting/stopping recordings and taking screenshots within the Cuttlefish project. It includes method declarations, class members, and external dependencies related to WebRTC control.

classes.name: WebRtcController
classes.description: A class that manages WebRTC control features such as starting/stopping recordings and capturing screenshots within the Cuttlefish environment.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the feature, 'WebRtcController'.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Performs setup operations for the WebRtcController, returning a Result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: GetClientSocket
methods.description: Returns the client socket associated with the WebRTC controller.

methods.name: SendStartRecordingCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to start recording via WebRTC.

methods.name: SendStopRecordingCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to stop recording via WebRTC.

methods.name: SendScreenshotDisplayCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to display a screenshot on a specified display.
